description: Create a temporary email inbox for testing the signup or email flow of a product the user owns or is authorised to test, within that product's terms. Returns an `address` to enter in the product's form and an `inbox_token` for reading it with check_inbox. Each inbox expires 24 hours after it is created, receives mail only (it cannot send), and accepts mail only while it exists. Up to 20 inboxes can be created per hour from one IP address.

review.description: Optional review slug this inbox belongs to — a label for your own bookkeeping.

name: create_inbox
